name: tabmaster-mcp

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List every page in Tab Manager, as a tree in display order, with how many groups and saved tabs each has. Start here.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Show one page: its body (every block in order, with block ids: text, headings, dividers, links to other pages, and the blocks that place its groups and subpages), its groups with their saved tabs (id, title, url), and its subpages. "root" shows the Hub: its body places the top-level pages, and it has no groups.

page.description: Page id, or its name. Use "Parent/Child" when two pages share a name. "root" for the Hub; "Hub" too, when no page has that name.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find pages, groups and saved tabs whose name, title or URL contains the text.

limit.description: Most results to return. 25 when left out.

tools.name: list_open_tabs
tools.description: List the tabs open in the browser right now, by window, with their tab ids, browser tab groups, the time each tab was last used, and where each tab is saved, if it is. Compare lastUsed with now to find idle tabs.

currentWindowOnly.description: Only the window the user used last.

tools.name: list_shortcuts
tools.description: List the Dashboard shortcuts: named, coloured sets of links that open together.

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Make a new page, optionally under a parent and with groups of saved tabs, in one step.

parent.description: Parent page id or name. "root" or null for the top level.

icon.description: One of: home, folder, work, price, palette, cookie, paint, shield, book, game, education, none.

url.description: Full URL. "github.com/x" is read as https://github.com/x.

title.description: Title to show. The domain when left out.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Rename a page, change its icon, fold or unfold it in the Hub tree, or move it: to another parent, or to a position among its siblings.

page.description: Page id, or its name. Use "Parent/Child" when two pages share a name.

icon.description: One of: home, folder, work, price, palette, cookie, paint, shield, book, game, education, none.

parent.description: Parent page id or name. "root" or null for the top level.

collapsed.description: true folds its subpages in the Hub tree.

tools.name: show_page
tools.description: Open a page, or the Hub, in Tab Manager and bring it to the front.

page.description: Page id, or its name. Use "Parent/Child" when two pages share a name. "root" for the Hub; "Hub" too, when no page has that name.

tools.name: add_blocks
tools.description: Add text, headings, dividers, or links to other pages, to a page body or the Hub. Give blocks, or markdown with one block per line ("# ", "## ", "### " for headings, "---" for a divider). New subpages and groups come from create_page and create_group.

page.description: Page id, or its name. Use "Parent/Child" when two pages share a name. "root" for the Hub; "Hub" too, when no page has that name.
For a link: the page it points at.

after.description: Put it just after this block.

before.description: Put it just before this block.

atStart.description: Put it at the top of the page. The end when no place is given.

tools.name: update_block
tools.description: Change the text of a text or heading block, turn one into the other, change a heading level, or point a link block at another page.

page.description: Page id, or its name. Use "Parent/Child" when two pages share a name. "root" for the Hub; "Hub" too, when no page has that name.

block.description: Block id, from the body that get_page shows.

linkTo.description: For a link block: the page it now points at.

tools.name: delete_blocks
tools.description: Delete text, heading, divider and link blocks from a page body or the Hub. Subpages and groups go with delete_page and delete_group. The user can undo it in Tab Manager.

page.description: Page id, or its name. Use "Parent/Child" when two pages share a name. "root" for the Hub; "Hub" too, when no page has that name.

items.description: Block id, from the body that get_page shows.

tools.name: move_block
tools.description: Move a block to another place in the same page body or the Hub. This also moves where a group or subpage shows on the page.

page.description: Page id, or its name. Use "Parent/Child" when two pages share a name. "root" for the Hub; "Hub" too, when no page has that name.

block.description: Block id, from the body that get_page shows.

after.description: Put it just after this block.

before.description: Put it just before this block.

atStart.description: Put it at the top of the page. The end when no place is given.

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete a page with all its subpages and groups. The user can undo it in Tab Manager.

page.description: Page id, or its name. Use "Parent/Child" when two pages share a name.

tools.name: reorder_pages
tools.description: Put the subpages of one parent in a new order. Pages left out keep their order after the named ones.

parent.description: Parent page id or name. "root" or null for the top level.

items.description: Page id, or its name. Use "Parent/Child" when two pages share a name.

tools.name: list_sidebar
tools.description: Show the sidebar: the pinned pages at the top, then each sidebar section with its pinned pages, in order. Sidebar sections only group pins; they are not pages.

tools.name: pin_page
tools.description: Pin a page to the sidebar, in a sidebar section or in the Pinned list at the top, or unpin it. A page that is already pinned moves to the new place.

page.description: Page id, or its name. Use "Parent/Child" when two pages share a name.

section.description: Sidebar section id or name. The Pinned list at the top when left out.

index.description: Position in the section, 0 first. The end when left out.

pinned.description: false to unpin. true when left out.

tools.name: create_sidebar_section
tools.description: Make a sidebar section: a labelled block of pinned pages in the sidebar.

index.description: Position among the sections, 0 first. The end when left out.

tools.name: update_sidebar_section
tools.description: Rename a sidebar section, fold or unfold it, or move it among the sections.

section.description: Sidebar section id, or its name.

tools.name: delete_sidebar_section
tools.description: Delete a sidebar section. Its pages stay pinned, in the Pinned list at the top. The user can undo it in Tab Manager.

section.description: Sidebar section id, or its name.

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Make a group of saved tabs on a page.

page.description: Page id, or its name. Use "Parent/Child" when two pages share a name.

url.description: Full URL. "github.com/x" is read as https://github.com/x.

title.description: Title to show. The domain when left out.

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Rename a group, move it to another page, or change how it shows: icon size, labels, columns, folded.

group.description: Group id, or its name. Use "Page/Group" when two groups share a name.

page.description: Page to move the group to.

showLabels.description: Show the tab titles under the icons.

viewMode.description: The default layout, or a list in 3 or 4 columns.

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Delete a group and its saved tabs. The user can undo it in Tab Manager.

group.description: Group id, or its name. Use "Page/Group" when two groups share a name.

tools.name: reorder_groups
tools.description: Put the groups of one page in a new order. Groups left out keep their order after the named ones.

page.description: Page id, or its name. Use "Parent/Child" when two pages share a name.

items.description: Group id, or its name. Use "Page/Group" when two groups share a name.

tools.name: add_tabs
tools.description: Add saved tabs to a group.

group.description: Group id, or its name. Use "Page/Group" when two groups share a name.

url.description: Full URL. "github.com/x" is read as https://github.com/x.

title.description: Title to show. The domain when left out.

index.description: Position in the group, 0 first. The end when left out.

tools.name: remove_tabs
tools.description: Remove saved tabs from their groups, by saved tab id (from get_page or search).

tools.name: move_tabs
tools.description: Move saved tabs, by saved tab id, into a group, in the order given.

toGroup.description: Group id, or its name. Use "Page/Group" when two groups share a name.

tools.name: update_tab
tools.description: Rename a saved tab, or change its link.

tabId.description: Saved tab id, from get_page or search.

title.description: The name to show. An empty text brings back the page's own title.

tools.name: save_open_tabs
tools.description: Save open browser tabs as a new group on a page. Saves every web tab in the window the user used last when no tab ids are given.

page.description: Page id, or its name. Use "Parent/Child" when two pages share a name.

closeAfter.description: Close the saved tabs afterwards. Pinned tabs stay open.

tools.name: open_tabs
tools.description: Open links as new browser tabs, optionally as one browser tab group. They open at the end of the window the user used last, right after a given tab, or in a new window.

groupTitle.description: Put the new tabs in a browser tab group with this title.

focus.description: Switch to the first new tab.

afterTab.description: Open them right after this tab, in its window. Inside a tab group, they join that group. A tab id from list_open_tabs.

newWindow.description: Open them in a new window.

tools.name: open_saved
tools.description: Open a saved group or a shortcut as a browser tab group, with all its links or only some. Links that are already open are reused, not opened twice.

group.description: Group id, or its name. Use "Page/Group" when two groups share a name.

tabs.description: Open only these links: each one a URL, a title, or an id from list_shortcuts or get_page. All links when left out.

tools.name: close_tabs
tools.description: Close browser tabs by tab id (from list_open_tabs). Tab Manager pages stay open.

tools.name: focus_tab
tools.description: Switch to a browser tab and bring its window to the front.

tools.name: update_open_tabs
tools.description: Pin or unpin open tabs, mute or unmute them, or reload them. Tab Manager pages do not reload.

tools.name: duplicate_tabs
tools.description: Open a copy of each tab, right after it.

tools.name: move_open_tabs
tools.description: Move open tabs, in the order given: to a new window, to another window, or to another place in the tab strip. Tabs that leave their window leave their browser tab group too.

windowId.description: The window to move them to, from list_open_tabs. The first tab's window when left out.

newWindow.description: Move them to a new window.

index.description: Position in the window, 0 first. The end when left out.

tools.name: merge_windows
tools.description: Move the tabs of every other browser window into one window. Browser tab groups move whole. The empty windows close. Private windows stay apart.

windowId.description: The window that gets the tabs. The window the user used last when left out.

tools.name: sort_tabs
tools.description: Sort the tabs of a window by site. Pinned tabs and browser tab groups keep their places; the other tabs go after them, one site after the other.

windowId.description: From list_open_tabs. The window the user used last when left out.

tools.name: search_history
tools.description: Search the browser history by words in the title or link, newest first, with where each page is saved, if it is. An empty query lists the latest pages.

days.description: How far back to look. 30 when left out.

limit.description: Most results to return. 25 when left out.

tools.name: list_other_devices
tools.description: List the tabs open on the user's other devices, such as a phone or another computer. It works only when browser sync is on.

limit.description: Most windows to show for each device. 10 when left out.

tools.name: sleep_tabs
tools.description: Put open tabs to sleep to free memory. They stay in the tab strip and load again when clicked. Without tab ids: every web tab that is not in front, pinned, or playing sound.

currentWindowOnly.description: Only the window the user used last.

tools.name: find_duplicate_tabs
tools.description: Find pages that are open more than once. For each, the tab that stays and the tab ids to close with close_tabs.

tools.name: list_recently_closed
tools.description: List the tabs and windows closed lately, newest first, with the session ids that restore_closed takes.

tools.name: restore_closed
tools.description: Open a closed tab or window again. The most recently closed one when no session id is given.

tools.name: group_tabs
tools.description: Put open browser tabs into a browser tab group: a new one, or the one given.

tabGroupId.description: Add to this browser tab group, from list_open_tabs.

tools.name: update_tab_group
tools.description: Rename a browser tab group, change its colour, fold or unfold it, or ungroup its tabs.

ungroup.description: Take every tab out of the group. The tabs stay open.

tools.name: create_shortcut
tools.description: Make a Dashboard shortcut: a named, coloured set of links that open together as one tab group.

url.description: Full URL. "github.com/x" is read as https://github.com/x.

title.description: Title to show. The domain when left out.

tools.name: update_shortcut
tools.description: Rename a shortcut, change its colour, add or remove links, or replace all its links. A shortcut keeps at least one link.

tabs.description: The new full list of links. Not with addTabs or removeTabs.

url.description: Full URL. "github.com/x" is read as https://github.com/x.

title.description: Title to show. The domain when left out.

addTabs.description: Links to add. They go at index, or at the end.

url.description: Full URL. "github.com/x" is read as https://github.com/x.

title.description: Title to show. The domain when left out.

removeTabs.description: Links to remove: each one a URL, a title, or an id from list_shortcuts.

index.description: Where addTabs go, 0 first. The end when left out. Removals happen first.

tools.name: delete_shortcut
tools.description: Delete a Dashboard shortcut. The user can undo it in Tab Manager.

tools.name: set_dashboard_pin
tools.description: Pin a link to the top of the Dashboard as a big tile, or unpin it.

pinned.description: false to unpin. true when left out.

tools.name: reorder_shortcuts
tools.description: Put the Dashboard shortcuts in a new order. Shortcuts left out keep their order after the named ones.

tools.name: reorder_dashboard_pins
tools.description: Put the Dashboard pins in a new order. Pins left out keep their order after the named ones.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Show the Dashboard: whether it opens on every new tab, its sections in order (shown or hidden, width, view), the pins and the shortcuts.

tools.name: update_dashboard
tools.description: Change the Dashboard: open it on every new tab or not, pins in a row, and its sections: show or hide, width, view, list columns and rows, and their order.

startHere.description: Open the Dashboard on every new tab.

view.description: shortcuts: pills or cards. most: tiles or list.

order.description: Sections in their new order. Sections left out follow.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Rank sites by use, as the Dashboard does, from the tabs the user focused and the browser history of the last 30 days. most: saved tabs used most. recent: saved tabs used last. unsaved: sites used often that are saved nowhere.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last change in Tab Manager, from Claude or from the user, or redo it. It works while the Tab Manager tab that made the change stays open.

redo.description: true to redo the last undone change.

tools.name: export_data
tools.description: Save a full backup of Tab Manager to a JSON file: pages, groups, saved tabs, page text, the sidebar, shortcuts and Dashboard pins. Returns the file path.

file.description: Where to save it. A new file in Downloads when left out. An existing file is never overwritten.

tools.name: import_data
tools.description: Import a JSON file from export_data, a shortcuts file, or a browser bookmarks HTML file. A full export replaces all data: give replaceAll true, and the server first saves a backup of the current data next to it in Downloads. Bookmarks and shortcuts are added to what is there.

file.description: Path of the file to import.

replaceAll.description: Required for a full export file, which replaces everything.
